name: Being Quiet
overview: Scripture reveals that being quiet is an expression of trust and wisdom rooted in reverence for God. Believers are called to hold their peace and be still, resting in the LORD’s sovereignty rather than fretting over the success of the wicked. True wisdom is shown in refraining from excessive speech and maintaining a calm, understanding heart toward others. This quietness allows one to acknowledge God’s exaltation and active presence as He fights on behalf of His people.
